lanes.summary: The diff meticulously implements all requirements for both PMAT-3601 and PMAT-3656. All ad-hoc size/name tables have been removed in favor of delegating to `trueno_quant::TRAITS`, ensuring types are perfectly sized and named. A comprehensive suite of regression, backward-compatibility, and error-handling tests was introduced, strictly asserting that unknown IDs or missing dequantizers produce well-formatted, contract-referencing errors rather than inventing approximate weights or raising confusing format errors. Contracts and roadmaps were also correspondingly updated. There is no evidence of regression or unsupported behavior.

findings.claim: apr inspect succeeds on a GGUF containing any of the 10 listed ids (repro: Qwen3.5-4B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf, dtype 23)
findings.fix: Added `test_3601_rosetta_inspect_accepts_an_iq4_xs_gguf` which explicitly builds a synthetic GGUF with dtype 23 (IQ4_XS) and ensures `inspect()` extracts the name and size correctly.

findings.claim: A regression test pins all 10 ids against shape.rs's byte_size
findings.fix: Added `test_3601_get_tensor_raw_sizes_every_iq_and_tq_type` which tests 11 IDs (including 16..=23) against `get_tensor_raw()` to verify exactly correct byte sizing in bytes/blocks.

findings.claim: The error message, if a truly unknown id is ever hit, names the id and points at contracts/apr-cli-commands-v1.yaml's inspect docs or similar — not a bare "Unsupported dtype N"
findings.fix: `unsized_ggml_type_error` now names the tensor and type ID, explains why it failed, and points to `contracts/ggml-type-v1.yaml`. A test `test_3601_unknown_id_is_refused_as_a_gap_in_apr` asserts this format.

findings.claim: apr tensors sized tensors from a second hand-typed table ... now type_size/blck_size from TRAITS
findings.fix: `ggml_dtype_element_size` was rewritten to calculate size via `trueno_quant::GgmlType::from_id`. `tensors_tests_stats.rs` was updated to verify the corrected byte elements for IQ-types and the 24-30 tail.

findings.claim: ggml_dtype_name ... reads TRAITS so TQ1_0/TQ2_0 are named rather than "unknown"
findings.fix: `ggml_dtype_name` delegates to `trueno_quant::GgmlType::from_id`. `test_3601_ggml_dtype_name_keeps_0_to_30_and_names_the_ids_past_it` checks backward compatibility for 0..=30 and correct naming for IDs like TQ1_0.

findings.claim: get_tensor_f32 on any IQ tensor returns Err naming the tensor and its type; no path in aprender-core returns approximated IQ values; dequantize_iq_approximate is deleted
findings.fix: `dequantize_iq_approximate` was completely removed from `dequantize.rs`. The match arm for IQ types in `shape.rs` now falls through to an explicit refusal error naming the tensor and its ID. This is backed by `test_3656_get_tensor_f32_refuses_iq_and_tq_instead_of_approximating`.

lanes.summary: The diff successfully resolves both tickets PMAT-3601 and PMAT-3656. It transitions `aprender-core` from using hardcoded, incomplete tables to reading `trueno_quant::TRAITS` for tensor block sizes and names. It also removes the `dequantize_iq_approximate` function to prevent inventing IQ-quant weights during import/conversion, and returns clear, descriptive error messages for unsupported or unknown types, pointing to relevant contracts. The regression tests fully cover the new functionality.

findings.claim: apr inspect sizes and names ggml types from trueno_quant::TRAITS, removing the hardcoded tables for sizing and naming.
Removes the IQ approximation in dequantization and properly refuses the formats it does not have a dequantizer for.
The error message for a truly unknown id names the id (via Display on GgmlTypeError) and points at contracts/ggml-type-v1.yaml, avoiding a bare 'Unsupported dtype N'.
Regression test pins all 10 ids against shape.rs's byte_size.

lanes.summary: Reviewed diff origin/main...HEAD against PMAT-3601 and PMAT-3656 tickets. The diff completely resolves both tickets by replacing hand-typed GGML size and name tables with trueno_quant::TRAITS in aprender-core (shape.rs, safetensors.rs, tensors.rs), deleting the IQ approximation code (dequantize_iq_approximate), and enforcing explicit refusal on get_tensor_f32 for unsupported IQ/TQ types while correctly sizing raw tensors for apr inspect / apr tensors. Contract invariants, Kani bounds, and comprehensive unit tests were updated and added. All 3,979 unit tests pass cleanly. No gates weakened, no unasked changes, no refutations found. Verdict: PASS.
